title: Configuration Technical Reference
readerIntent: Locate authoritative configuration contracts and extension boundaries.
priorKnowledge: Read the configuration overview and runtime pages.
summary: Technical ownership is distributed across startup configuration, module configuration, topology, tenant properties, and explicitly governed runtime contracts.

sections.heading: Authoritative locations
items: config/properties.js: configurable application and module behavior.
config/config.js: loader and configuration-definition contracts where owned by the framework.
Environment, server, and node modules: topology composition and selection.
Tenant or customer property layers: supported business-scope variation.
Runtime-governance schemas, services, interceptors, and audit records: approved mutable contracts.
package.json: standard package and limited module metadata, not general application configuration.

sections.heading: Non-negotiable boundaries
items: Do not create duplicate loaders or parallel authority paths.
Do not put credentials or secrets in committed properties.
Do not convert executable business logic into unvalidated data.
Do not treat root docs/ as runtime configuration.
Do not allow runtime mutation of a contract that has no validation, authorization, audit, and rollback design.
